name: Lithium 0.26.3 for Fabric
changelog:
Lithium 0.26.3 for Minecraft 26.3.x fixes several issues.

Make sure to take a backup of your world before using the mod and please report any bugs and mod compatibility issues at the [issue tracker](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/lithium-fabric/issues). You can check the [description of each optimization](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/lithium/blob/mc26.3-0.26.3/lithium-mixin-config.md) and how to disable it when encountering a problem.

## Fixes
- Avoid caching chest inventories when the corresponding block state is a chest half
- Fix removed player memory leak in MapItemSavedData when maps are in item frames. Also avoid sending unnecessary map data packets
- Fix entity step up movement collision not including hard entities

name: Lithium 0.26.2 for Fabric
